linkLabel: holds a reference to the one instance

frames.narration: No AppConfig exists yet. Nothing is created until someone asks.
Header asks for the instance. This is the first request, so the Singleton creates it now.
Header saves a setting on the shared object.
Footer asks for the instance. It already exists, so the same object comes back. No second one is made.
Footer reads the theme and sees the value Header wrote, because both talk to the same object.
Some code tries new AppConfig() directly. The constructor refuses, so the single instance rule holds.
